results.answer:

Question: Can I cancel my order before it is dispatched?

Answer based only on retrieved context:
If the order has already been shipped, the customer may need to receive the
order and follow the applicable return process instead.

Cancellation availability can depend on the current status of the order.
Customers should check their order details for the available cancellation
option.

Nykaa Support Knowledge Base
Document: Cancellation Policy

Customers can request cancellation of an order before the order has been
dispatched.

Once an order has been shipped, cancellation may no longer be possible
through the normal cancellation process.

If cancellation is successfully completed before dispatch, the customer will
not receive the cancelled items.

For prepaid orders, an eligible refund for a successfully cancelled order is
processed to the original payment method.

If the estimated delivery date has passed and there has been no meaningful
tracking update, the customer should contact support with the order details.

A delayed shipment does not automatically mean that the order has been
cancelled.

If an order cannot be delivered because of a logistics issue, the customer
may receive further instructions or an applicable resolution from support.

results.answer:

Question: When is Cash on Delivery available?

Answer based only on retrieved context:
Nykaa Support Knowledge Base
Document: Cash on Delivery Policy

Cash on Delivery (COD) may be available only for eligible products,
locations, and orders.

The availability of COD is determined during checkout based on the delivery
address, product eligibility, and other applicable conditions.

Customers should have the required payment amount available when the order is
delivered.

For Cash on Delivery orders, the customer may need to provide valid bank
account or other required payment details to receive the refund.

If a refund has been initiated but the customer has not received it within
the expected processing period, the customer should contact support with the
relevant order details.

Refunds are not guaranteed for products that fail the applicable return
eligibility or inspection requirements.

If an order has been shipped, the customer can use the available tracking
details to monitor its progress.

If the estimated delivery date has passed and the order has not been
delivered, the customer should check the latest tracking information before
contacting support.

Delivery may take longer during high-demand periods, sales events, holidays,
or unexpected logistical disruptions.

Question: What should I do if an item is missing from my order?

Answer based only on retrieved context:
If an item was not included in the shipment, the resolution may include
delivery of the missing item, a refund, or another applicable resolution.

Customers should retain the delivered products and packaging until the issue
has been reviewed, as these may be required during the investigation.

If the package appears damaged or tampered with when delivered, the customer
should report this information along with the missing-item complaint.

Nykaa Support Knowledge Base
Document: Missing or Incomplete Order Policy

If a customer receives an order with a missing item, they should report the
issue to customer support as soon as possible.

The customer should provide the relevant order details and any information
requested by support to help investigate the issue.

Support may review the order information, shipment details, and other
available records before determining the appropriate resolution.

If the requested replacement is unavailable, the customer may be offered an
alternative resolution according to the applicable policy.

Products that have been used, damaged after delivery, or do not meet the
applicable exchange conditions may not qualify for an exchange.

For damaged, defective, or incorrect products, customers should report the
issue as soon as possible and provide the information requested by support.
